description.value:
Your dismissed Cloth is not merely stored — it is sent, and it can find you again across any distance.

When you dismiss your Cloth, you may send it to a pocket of folded space instead of collapsing it into a box or onto your body. While there it is beyond the reach of any effect. As an activity taking 10 minutes, you may summon it to your current location from anywhere on the same plane; from another plane it arrives after 24 hours, travelling the dimensional roads on its own.

Your Cloth can also act as a courier. You may send it away carrying a single object of 2 Bulk or less, name a destination you have visited, and it will travel there and back over 24 hours. A Saint's Cloth cannot be intercepted, tracked, or compelled while travelling — only destroyed, and only by something that can catch it.
